name: Redis MCP
tagline: Full Redis access for AI agents — strings, hashes, streams, pub/sub.
shortDescription: The official Redis MCP server. Exposes Redis commands (GET, SET, HSET, LPUSH, XADD, etc.) as MCP tools your agent can call. Supports standalone Redis, Redis Cluster, and Redis Stack.
longDescription:
## What it is

The official Redis MCP server maintained by Redis Inc. It exposes the most-used Redis commands as MCP tools, so your agent can read/write keys, manage lists and hashes, publish to streams, and run Lua scripts — all from chat.

## Why we recommend it

It's the canonical Redis integration. The team that builds Redis also builds this server, so you get first-class support for new Redis features the day they ship. The auth model is solid (password, ACL, TLS) and it works with Redis Cloud, Redis Stack (with the search and JSON modules), and self-hosted clusters.

## When to use it

- Caching layers your agent needs to read or invalidate
- Stream-based event pipelines (XADD, XREAD, consumer groups)
- Pub/sub for agent-to-agent communication
- Rate limiting, session storage, leaderboards
installInstructions:
**Docker (recommended):**
1. `docker run -d -p 6379:6379 redis:7`
2. Set `REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379`
3. `npx -y @redis/mcp-redis`

**Production:**
- Use a managed Redis (Upstash, Redis Cloud) with TLS
- Set `REDIS_URL=rediss://default:password@host:port`
pricingDetails: Free. Redis itself is free and open source. Managed Redis (Upstash, Redis Cloud) starts at $0/month for the free tier.
